item.title: Student Senate reviews 2.5% undergraduate tuition increase
item.description: The EIU Student Senate reviewed resolutions recommending a proposed tuition increase for the 2026 fiscal year at its meeting on Wednesday. The increase would be 2.5% for undergraduate tuition and 2.90% for graduate tuition. Fees would stay the same.
